description: Data-backed exact semantic-definition placeholder policies for the split-conformal source-theorem frontier. These policies guide source lookup, authoring, and semantic review only; they are not Lean proof evidence.

placeholder_policies.semantic_goal: Define finite exchangeability as permutation-invariant joint law of the score process, not only pairwise score-order symmetry.

definition_contract.semantic_intent: finite calibration/test score family has a permutation-invariant joint law under the probability measure
definition_contract.lean_target_shape: predicate over `P : Measure Ω` and `s : Fin (n + 1) -> Ω -> ℝ`
required_properties: sufficient to derive uniform rank or bad-rank budget support lemmas
forbidden_shortcuts: do not define Exchangeable as True
do not assume the split_conformal_coverage target theorem

placeholder_policies.draft_definition:
def Exchangeable {Ω : Type _} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {ι : Type _} [Fintype ι]
    (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (s : ι → Ω → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm ι,
    MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω : Ω => fun i : ι => s (σ i) ω) P =
      MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω : Ω => fun i : ι => s i ω) P
